title: Navy SEAL finds a black octagonal structure near McMurdo

tellings.quote: highly polished black stone octagonal structure sticking out like 18 ft above the ice.

plain: A Navy SEAL is said to have found a "highly polished black stone octagonal structure" rising about 18 feet above the ice near McMurdo, the American research station in Antarctica. The philosopher Jason Jorjani passes this on to Michels from the writer Linda Moulton Howe, so it comes to us at least third-hand. If true, it would mean a built structure lies buried in the Antarctic ice.
